hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}'   || true ;; esac

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) case "$CMD" in *CLAUDE.md*) :;; *) git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qx CLAUDE.md || echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"DOCS-WITH-CODE rule (this project): CLAUDE.md is not part of this commit. If the change introduced a new pattern, bug class, API, or constraint, update CLAUDE.md and memory/project_state.md and git add them before committing."}}';; esac;; esac
